list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, verified against the Exophase and PSNProfiles lists on 2026-11-19; PSN progress targets from PSNProfiles.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy on the list and it unlocks itself: finish the other 54 and it pops at once. Follow this guide's roadmap from stage 1 to stage 5 and keep the checklist ticked as you go, so nothing is left for a second run. There is no separate task behind it — it is the reward for the whole list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing, the game's opening mission, following the objectives on screen until the mission-complete screen. It is the first thing the game asks you to do, so it unlocks naturally and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (mission order)

trophies.guide: Keep playing the story missions in order until Chapter 1 ends. Story trophies unlock as you play, so there is nothing extra to do — just do not stop halfway through the chapter. One warning for later: the first meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude is reported to sit in Chapter 1, so meditate there before the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on the Chapter 1 meditation)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its missions in order. By this point both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the open-world trophies open up alongside the story, so start ticking off side content as you go.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (both characters playable from Chapter 2)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its missions in order. If you are working the side content as you go, keep the stranger chains ticked off as they appear instead of leaving them for later.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its missions in order. The optional Chapter 4 bank mission behind Maximum Withdrawal becomes available around here — take it when it appears, because it opens the vault robberies.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (Maximum Withdrawal and its Chapter 4 mission)

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Save the game before the last mission if you want a clean point to return to for cleanup, then play it through to the credits. This is the hidden gold of the set, so it stays concealed in your trophy list until it pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (the hidden gold)

trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run to the end. Story missions unlock in order, so keep following the story markers until this one appears and completes.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play the mission The Cartel Heist to the end. It is a story mission, so it arrives in sequence — no preparation needed beyond showing up and finishing it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play to the end. Like the other mission trophies, it pops when the mission-complete screen shows.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners to the end. Keep playing the story in order and it will come — there is no side requirement behind it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown to the end. The mission's name points at the airport, so expect a set piece there — finish it and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory to the end. It is a later story mission, so just keep the campaign moving and it will arrive in turn.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion by finishing the game's full checklist. PowerPyx and GTABase rank this the hardest trophy, but note the thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60 percent of true completion, and most of the progress comes from the other trophies. The checklist has to be finished after the story, so treat it as the last big job before the platinum. Note the checklist asks for more than the trophies do in places — 300 stunts against the trophy's 250, 30 races won against 20, 70 challenges against 50, 15 card sets against 3, 8 bank vaults against 5 — so finish the trophy targets first and keep going.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 100)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx and GTABase on the 100 percent checklist)

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida. GTABase and PowerPyx report that any 250 of the game's 397 stunts count, and that flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack them up. Pick a fast plane, learn a bridge route, and repeat it — the counter climbs fast once you have the line.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 250)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx stunt counts)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Work through them one at a time — fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races and the rest — and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. PSN tracks the count out of 9, so check the in-game list to see which types you still owe.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 9)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Take them one range at a time, learn each challenge's par, and replay the ones that fall short — gold in all 42 is what the trophy checks. PSN tracks the count out of 42, so the range menu shows how many golds you still owe.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 42)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (all 42 challenges)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 locations, so expect several races per spot. Learn each course once, then race to win — a win at every location is what counts, not a win in every single race.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 14)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: 42 races across 14 locations)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, so spread your wins across race types instead of repeating one favourite. PSN tracks the count out of 20, and the 100 percent checklist asks for 30 — winning 20 comes first, then keep going for the checklist.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 20)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (checklist asks for 30 races won)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish him. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest game in the arcade, learn its controls, and play it through — a single completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Start Andy's stranger chain as soon as it unlocks: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, warns that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave the chain sitting. Play each of Andy's missions when it appears and the final one pops this trophy.
trophies.missableNote: Possible window: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, reports that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress. Start Andy's chain as soon as it unlocks and play each mission when it appears.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Same rule as the other stranger chains: begin Kenton's strand early and play each mission as it appears, since the chain's window is tied to story progress.
trophies.missableNote: Possible window: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, reports that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress. Start Kenton's chain as soon as it unlocks.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Start Billy's chain early and follow it through to its final mission — do not let the strand sit while the story moves on.
trophies.missableNote: Possible window: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, reports that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress. Start Billy's chain as soon as it unlocks.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Work the strands as they appear during the story — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest — and keep count in this guide's checklist. Eight finished strands is the target; PSN tracks it out of 8. Note the five stranger-final trophies are flagged as possibly missable, so start each chain early.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 8)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (TechWiser on stranger-chain windows, single source)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Start Randy's chain as soon as it unlocks and play it through; the stranger chains are reported to have story-linked windows, so early is safer than late.
trophies.missableNote: Possible window: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, reports that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress. Start Randy's chain as soon as it unlocks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (TechWiser on stranger-chain windows, single source)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Start Tyrone's chain early and follow it to its final mission, the same as the other four stranger finals.
trophies.missableNote: Possible window: TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, reports that stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress. Start Tyrone's chain as soon as it unlocks.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. GTABase and PowerPyx flag this as the only trophy that might be missable: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is reported to disappear once that chapter ends. Both guides say it is unconfirmed whether that spot is required — so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe, then find the rest as you explore. PSN tracks the count out of 18, though EGamers notes GTABase counts 18 spots while the 100 percent checklist counts 15, so the two may count different things — keep meditating until the trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy two guides flag as possibly missable. The first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, reported to disappear once that chapter ends. Both guides say it is unconfirmed whether that spot is required — do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 18)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx missable warning, count disagreement)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's strand when it appears and follow it to the hunt; which animal it asks for is still unconfirmed in the guides, so follow Bret's directions in the mission itself rather than guessing. Start the strand early, like the other stranger chains.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (which animal is unconfirmed)

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect cards as you explore and find the ones each set needs; three finished sets is the target, while the 100 percent checklist asks for 15, so this trophy comes well before the full collection. PSN tracks the count out of 3.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 3)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (checklist asks for 15 sets)

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app wherever the prompt appears and log the spot; busy streets and landmarks give you plenty of chances. PSN tracks the count out of 100, and the 100 percent checklist asks for the same 100, so this one pulls double duty.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 100)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (checklist asks for the same 100)

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the challenge list in the game menu and tick them off as you play — most complete naturally while chasing other trophies. PSN tracks the count out of 50; the 100 percent checklist asks for 70, so keep going after this one pops.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 50)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (checklist asks for 70 challenges)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then lose the heat and escape. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies often bring on the wanted level. Get to 4 stars together, break line of sight, and stay out of the red heat zone until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on the escape route)

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Stay wanted through all three robberies — do not escape the heat between them. The guides suggest the jewelry stores of North Vice City, which sit close together, and GTABase adds that if the trophy does not pop after the third, a fourth robbery fixes it.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase on shop choice and the fourth robbery)

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. According to GTABase, you scan them with WAiNK — there is no need to drive each one. Cruise busy roads and scan the traffic around you; PSN tracks the count out of 100, so the counter climbs while you drive normally.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 100)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase: scan with WAiNK, no need to drive)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter before you start, pick a fight with gang members — the guides report that gang members count while cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to — and use an assault rifle to drop five before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on who counts)

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. GTABase reports the method as stealing a docked passenger jet and flying about a kilometre away from the airport. Get aboard, get airborne, and put distance between you and the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase on the jet)

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and make it count. GTABase reports the method as stealing a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and taking out enemies from inside it. Expect heavy resistance on the way in — bring a fast vehicle and a plan for the way out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase on Mile Zero Air Station)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The guides describe the approach as opening the store's back door with the Snap Gun, finding the safe code, and clearing out the safe without anyone spotting you. Move slowly, stay out of sight lines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase on the Snap Gun approach)

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The method runs through the optional Chapter 4 mission called That's Where The Money Is…: after it, follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out and have a fast bike ready for the escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways; PSN tracks the count out of 5, while the 100 percent checklist asks for 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 5)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on the Chapter 4 mission and escape)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the wanted level pins you down.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas the game tracks. The guides say this means clearing the fog across the map, and that flying over the dark patches is the quickest method. Work through the map region by region until no fog is left; PSN tracks the count out of 52.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 52)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on clearing the fog)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. GTABase counts 9 gangs, so you need one operation from each of the 9. Find each gang's turf, hit its operation, and repeat until all nine are ticked off; PSN tracks the count out of 9.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 9)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase: one operation from each of 9 gangs)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in the published guides — PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known — so head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. The description itself is the hint: a drink, a view, Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: not yet known)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The steps are still unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks it not yet known — while GTABase thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window. Take a car into a showroom and drive it out through the glass; if it does not pop, try a different showroom.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: not yet known; GTABase on the showroom window)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the alley, play a frame, and follow through on your throw — the guide wording is unclear, so play a full game there and the trophy should follow.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (wording unclear)

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase reports this one as maxing out Strength for both characters. Train both Jason's and Lucia's Strength to the top and the trophy should pop during the campaign.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (official list)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase: max out Strength for both characters)

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. GTABase links this to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change it. Play the way you want across the campaign and the count climbs; PSN tracks it out of 500. EGamers warns that the guides also say Irredeemable is permanent, so check the Criminal Profile consequences before going on a rampage.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 500)

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The trigger is still unconfirmed in the published guides — PowerPyx marks it not yet known. The description points at succeeding on a second try, so if something fails once, try it again right away.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The steps are still unconfirmed in the published guides. Our own reading of the name and description: a drive-by with a melee weapon, aimed to knock someone down the way a bowling ball knocks pins — try it from a moving vehicle and see if it registers. sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)

trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder the bills through fences; GTABase notes one fence pays the most, and the total grows during the 100 percent robberies. Keep feeding bills to your contacts and PSN's counter climbs toward $250,000.

sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 250000)

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play — the total is cumulative across every shop, so normal spending adds up. PSN tracks it out of $100,000, and big late-game purchases will close the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 100000)
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, at around $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count. Save up, buy them one at a time, and the trophy pops on the eighth. PSN tracks the count out of 8.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PSN target 0 of 8)
EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (GTABase: 8 garages, around $160,000; story garages do not count)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles worth keeping, open the app, and register each one — ten registrations is the target. PSN tracks the count out of 10, so the app shows how many you still owe.
trophies.name: On the Spot
